lines.text: The writer uses large letters, writing to the Galatians with his own hand.
Those pushing circumcision want to avoid persecution for the cross of Christ, and want to boast in the Galatians' freedom.
He will boast only in the cross of Christ, through which the world has been crucified to him.
Only a new creation counts, and he wishes love and peace to all who walk by this rule.
He bears the marks of Jesus and asks that the Lord Jesus Christ's grace be with their spirit.
